author: Firm A — balancing desk
text: Bidding up at marginal cost to be ready for shortage. Bidding down slightly above cost to capture profit if long system continues with moderate surplus, aiming to set low imbalance price for firm's overall position.

author: Firm B — trading desk
text: Expecting long system based on alternating pattern and rest market persistence. Taking long position to benefit from imbalance price above day-ahead. Balancing desk: bid down at floor to avoid activation and help keep imbalance price high.

author: Firm B — balancing desk
text: Expecting short system based on recent alternation. Bidding up at 81 to potentially raise imbalance price if shortage exceeds 80 MW. Down at floor to avoid activation and protect trading desk.

author: Firm C — trading desk
text: Expect mean reversion to long system based on alternating pattern. Taking large short position to profit from imbalance price below day-ahead. Final period, maximum risk.

author: Firm C — balancing desk
text: Last period of simulation. Given persistent imbalance and possibility of large deviation due to cumulative trading positions, bidding at extremes (1000 up, -200 down) to capture potential profit from large shortage or surplus. Compliant with REMIT.
